scope: Manual complete-file source review against fixed candidate

reviews.notes: Complete pure scoped operational snapshot/CAS candidate:16KiB fixed struct JSON, exact bytes and domain commitment, scope/node binding, safe-integer revision and frozen parent/candidate bytes. PreparedSettings grants no durable authorization or effect.
Complete monotonic fixed-window resource admission; bounded counter, one-second reopen and permanent poison on elapsed rollback. This is neither client identity nor a detection signal.

Complete1..30000ms drain request and strictly positive supervisor slack below manager deadline, checked overflow; pure budget relation is not blocking-I/O preemption, actual child reaping or service stop execution.
Complete strict resource-only schema and five bounds match public operator table; unknown scoring/secret fields reject. Validation alone does not durably apply a change.

Complete expected profile construction, external witness presence separate from independence false, optional management/settings revision, TLS/H1 readiness excluding H2/collector. Declared readiness and source tests are not runtime or deployment attestation.

Complete bounded shutdown report/failure accounting; success only when both drain and audit flush return success, all failure combinations preserved without underlying sensitive errors. No stop/reaping result inferred from enum or serialization.

Complete342-line private lifetime-locked native state plus witnessed journal selection, explicit CreateNew/Existing/pending recovery, exact envelope/parent/revision, durability policy, stage/audit/finalize/check sequence and poison across ambiguity. Caller still owes serialized apply/liveness; modeled selection tests are not power-loss proof.

Complete97-line authenticated-record-only operational head: exact event/node/tenant/config/revision/digest, consecutive revisions and witnessed coverage, append/flush and final witness check. HTTP JSON cannot mint a head; same-process witness fixtures do not establish independent deployment.
